search_window.basis: Supplementary discovery relative to most recent verified ledger run; the article's hour-specific publication or revision time could not be verified. Retrospective discoveries distinguished from changes definitely occurring in this one-hour window.

findings.title: Israeli drone attacks kill seven Palestinians in central Gaza
findings.location: Near entrance to Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Palestinians killed in Israeli drone strike; a possibly revised count of two where prior WAFA report named one death; not additional confirmed deaths
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Two Palestinians were also killed when an Israeli drone struck civilians
findings.source_type: Established international news outlet reporting casualty account from Gaza
findings.finding_summary: Al Jazeera reports two killed near Deir al-Balah on November 20, whereas predecessor WAFA reporting named one killed, Firas Aqel, in Deir al-Balah. Likely overlapping incident, but exact event matching and whether this is a casualty revision or different incident remain unverified. Do not add two to the earlier one; AP's prior six-person daily aggregate and Al Jazeera's seven-person aggregate also differ by one.

bounded_discovery_context.search_priority: OCHA OPT and WHO first, 12 additional targeted searches; searched for new traceable items and retrospective misses
bounded_discovery_context.discovery_type: Newly located established-source account conflicting with earlier casualty figure
bounded_discovery_context.other_agencies: WAFA November 20 reported Firas Aqel; Associated Press earlier reported one death in Deir al-Balah. Al Jazeera reports two; its article's exact revision time is not verified.

findings.title: Israeli drone attacks kill seven Palestinians in central Gaza
findings.location: Al-Shuja'iyya, eastern Gaza City; east of Khan Younis near the Yellow Line
findings.affected_population_or_system: Residential buildings and civilian infrastructure in areas near Israeli-controlled military line; number of buildings affected and direct displacement impact unknown
findings.exact_supporting_passage: It also carried out three large-scale demolitions near the “Yellow Line”
findings.source_type: Established international news outlet reporting military demolition activity
findings.finding_summary: Al Jazeera reports Israeli military demolitions using explosive-laden drones in Al-Shuja'iyya and three large-scale demolition operations east of Khan Younis on Friday November 20. No count of demolished structures, injuries, or forced displacement was established; the number three refers to operations, not confirmed buildings.

bounded_discovery_context.note: Al Jazeera's reporting links military demolition operations to continued destruction of buildings and homes near the Yellow Line. Neither additional civilian impact details nor independent geolocation was verified.

direct_source_checks.detail: Direct article states two killed in Deir al-Balah and demolition operations in Al-Shuja'iyya/east Khan Younis. Publication date only; exact time not shown.
Index and Deir al-Balah report reviewed for casualty comparison; new items after 19:45 Jerusalem mostly West Bank/diplomatic and excluded.
Predecessor identified AP total six across Nuseirat, Deir al-Balah, Bureij; no new independent verified update this check.

excluded_candidates: Bureij four dead, Nuseirat one killed, Al-Maghazi five injured, Al-Sabra four injured, Deir al-Balah one killed WAFA baseline, all previously recorded; not counted as distinct strikes.
Al Jazeera reported aggregate seven versus prior AP six; only potentially changed Deir al-Balah component recorded, not a separate aggregate finding.
AI-assisted GazaNews.live item echoes Deir al-Balah two deaths without independently source-verified support; not used as primary evidence.
UNICEF World Children's Day launch and Italy partnership are program/advocacy announcements, not verified material delivery or access changes this hour.
OCHA retrospective November 10–16 healthcare, shelter, aid, access, food and water metrics already examined by preceding watches.
West Bank-only incidents, older conflict reports, opinions and unsupported social claims excluded.

Some agency pages were index-only; WHO global and OCHA accessible, coverage remained useful.
limitations: Neither Al Jazeera's exact article publication/revision clock time nor all incident times could be independently verified.
Deir al-Balah casualty counts differ by source; findings must not be counted additively until incident matching and hospital-source reporting are reconciled.
Al Jazeera demolitions were not independently corroborated or quantified as a building count; report only what the source established.
Production collector state not inspected; no decision made about production deduplication or publishing.
